title: Real Estate Website
description: Property listings with admin CRM — how it works, RERA fields, and commands to generate your project.

blocks.text: The real-estate template is built for agencies and developers who list apartments, plots, and villas with RERA-aware consent text, slug-based property pages, and lead export. Unlike a hotel site, the primary content is projects/properties with pricing hints, location tabs, and new-launch badges — all editable from /admin.

Property microsites need trustworthy legal text, RERA references, enquiry capture per listing, and fast updates when inventory changes. This template separates marketing copy (constants/site.ts) from inventory (database + admin) so sales teams can add properties without redeploying.

blocks.title: Demo brand
blocks.text: Default content uses Greenfield Properties in Pune (Baner). Swap branding and seed data for your client.

items: Property grid with apartments / plots tabs
Slug detail pages per property with media and enquiry forms
RERA fields on listings and legal.agentRera for site-wide consent
Promo banner CMS and optional LeadRat integration
Same Prisma + MariaDB + Docker stack as other templates

blocks.text: Init supports --agent-rera for the agency RERA number used in consent and footer text. Hotel templates use --temple-distance for landmark copy instead. Both share core brand flags; the difference is which optional fields appear in prompts and in the command builder for this template.

Build a command for first-time generation, or for later phases (theme, brand, database) inside an existing project. Fields with dropdowns list CLI-supported presets; text fields can be left empty and will not appear in the final command.
